$comment: AdCP 3.3 creator sales-authorization profile. All entities, credentials, and endpoints are fictional, and the signing key is a public test key.

cases.name: verified-credential
cases.description: A current credential from the selling agent's operator, attached to its own channel, with an active status. It carries no anchor.

cases.name: digest-mismatch
cases.description: content_digest does not match the embedded credential bytes.

cases.name: wrong-credential-typ
cases.description: The credential header typ is not adcp-creator-assertion+jws, so the JWS profile rejects it before any request.

cases.name: credential-moved-to-another-channel
cases.description: A valid credential for one channel sits on another channel's property.

cases.name: issuer-is-not-the-selling-agent-operator
cases.description: The selling agent's registrable domain is not the issuer's, so the issuer is untrusted before any request.

cases.name: selling-agent-not-listed-by-issuer
cases.description: The issuer's brand.json lists no sales agent with the selling agent's URL.

cases.name: key-without-attestation-purpose
cases.description: The signing key in the selected JWKS carries another adcp_use.

cases.name: same-kid-different-key
cases.description: The JWKS has a key with the credential's kid but different key material.

cases.name: tampered-signature
cases.description: The credential signature does not verify.

cases.name: payload-subject-differs-from-reference
cases.description: The signed payload names a different channel than the reference that carries it.

cases.name: seller-is-not-the-issuer
cases.description: value.seller names a party other than the issuer.

cases.name: evidence-account-does-not-match-subject
cases.description: evidence.account names a different channel than the subject.

cases.name: expired-credential
cases.description: expires_at has passed.

cases.name: status-url-off-issuer-domain
cases.description: status_url is not on the issuer brand's domain, so the status is unverifiable with no status request.

cases.name: status-fetch-fails
cases.description: The status request fails, which is unverifiable, never revoked.

cases.name: status-with-wrong-typ
cases.description: The status JWS carries the credential typ.

cases.name: status-for-another-credential
cases.description: The status answers for a different credential_id.

cases.name: stale-status
cases.description: The status next_update has passed, so it is not current.

cases.name: paused-credential
cases.description: A paused credential fails as revoked. Resuming issues a new credential.

cases.name: revoked-credential
cases.description: The issuer has withdrawn the claim.

cases.name: unknown-credential
cases.description: The issuer does not recognize the credential_id.

cases.name: anchor-confirmed
cases.description: The anchor url is the channel address built from the channel ID, and the page contains the expected text.

cases.name: anchor-url-with-trailing-slash
cases.description: A trailing slash on the anchor url is ignored when it is compared with the channel address.

cases.name: anchor-url-is-another-channel
cases.description: The anchor url is another channel's address on the same platform. It fails before any anchor request, even though that page contains the expected text.

cases.name: anchor-url-off-platform-domain
cases.description: The anchor url is on another domain, so it is not the profile address built from the identifier. It fails before any anchor request.

cases.name: anchor-text-missing
cases.description: The page is fetched, and it does not contain the expected text exactly. Its text differs in case.

cases.name: anchor-page-fetch-fails
cases.description: The anchor request fails. The credential stays verified, and the anchor is unconfirmed.

cases.name: anchor-confirmed-for-tiktok-username
cases.description: A tiktok_id subject. The anchor url is the profile address built from the username.

cases.name: anchor-username-address-without-at-sign
cases.description: A tiktok_id subject. The anchor url omits the @ that the profile address carries, so it fails before any anchor request.

cases.name: anchor-confirmed-for-instagram-handle
cases.description: An instagram_handle subject. The anchor url is the profile address built from the username.

cases.name: anchor-unconfirmed-for-instagram-account-id
cases.description: An instagram_account_id subject. No profile address is built from the account ID, so the evaluator cannot tie the page to the account. The anchor is unconfirmed with no anchor request, even though the page contains the expected text.

cases.name: anchor-text-does-not-name-the-issuer
cases.description: The expected text does not contain the issuer brand's domain. It fails before any anchor request, even though the page contains that text.

cases.name: anchor-of-unknown-type
cases.description: The anchor is of a type this profile does not define. The credential stays verified and the anchor is unconfirmed.

cases.name: anchor-confirmed-for-handle-with-at-sign
cases.description: An instagram_handle subject whose identifier carries a leading @. The @ is dropped when the profile address is built.

cases.name: credential-outlives-its-evidence
cases.description: expires_at is more than 7 days after evidence.verified_at.

cases.name: credential-without-status-url
cases.description: The credential carries no status_url, so the evaluator makes no status request.

cases.name: anchor-not-evaluated-for-revoked-credential
cases.description: A revoked credential has no anchor result, and the evaluator makes no anchor request.
